import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
y=dA_dt
def run(f,gen,n=80):
    best=None
    rng=np.random.default_rng(2)
    for _ in range(n):
        p0=gen(rng)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-y, p0, max_nfev=4000)
            if np.all(np.isfinite(r.fun)) and (best is None or r.cost<best.cost): best=r
        except Exception: pass
    if best is None: return None
    return np.mean((f(best.x)-y)**2)/np.var(y), np.round(best.x,4)
